next_action.description: Move the gallery Record button off the filter row. The visible toolbar is MpiGalleryGrid's __tabs row (js/components/Compounds/MpiGalleryGrid/MpiGalleryGrid.js:111-131), NOT MpiGalleryBlock's header - that one never reaches the DOM. Fabio named two homes: next to the volume (zone--center, after __volume-wrap - recommended, it is already the media-controls zone and cannot collide with the filters) or next to FLOWS in the app top bar (js/shell/projectUI.js:81). Then delete .mpi-gallery-block__actions from MpiGalleryBlock.js and .css. After that, settle the WAV question - plan.md holds the full trade-off, do not re-derive it.

key_decisions: The recorder re-muxes to WAV because `.webm` is VIDEO by extension in five server lists, so a native-container recording is re-typed to video on the first project reload. The EXTENSION forced this, not the codec - so mp3/m4a/ogg/flac/aac/opus are all equally safe, and switching format does not reopen the bug.
A recording is NOT an import: it skips onImport and takes the gallery-drop route (uploadMediaFile then media:imported), so it lands as a real audio card rather than only filling a slot.

MEDIA_TYPE.AUDIO promotion is gated on the OP declaring audio output, never on 'no urls but an audio one' - a video run that saved its soundtrack and then failed is also empty-with-audio, and promoting that turns a broken generation into a card.
Fabio chose the gallery as the entry point (2026-08-22) because the planned picker-only route was unreachable: no Flow declares an audio media group and the PromptBox's LTX audio slots are drag-only.
constraints: MpiGalleryBlock's own header is DEAD MARKUP - MpiGalleryGrid.mount(el) sets el.innerHTML and wipes the block's template, so its crumb/filters/sort slots render nothing while their CSS is live. Pre-existing, left alone, worth its own card. This is what put the Record button in a floating bar.

Installing an Electron permission handler INVERTS the default for every permission. fullscreen (video control bar, focus mode) and pointerLock (MpiRadialMenu) were being granted by the absent default and both fail silently - they are in the allowlist and asserted by the desktop spec. Desktop notifications are main-process and must NOT be added.

js/data/commandRegistry.js, js/data/flowsRegistry.js and js/components/types.js are also on MPI-567's and MPI-599's file lists. Edits here were additive (one enum key, one typedef block, one props block); check for drift before touching them again.

Verification split by environment on purpose: getUserMedia is NotAllowedError in a playwright browser and granted in real Electron, so the mic permission is only provable through tests/desktop/. Use `npm run app:isolated` and drive the printed READY url - never :3000.
